case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear colleagues at Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH,

Thank you for your quote. We have read your remarks on the cost indices carefully.

Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.39; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.42; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.38; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We value our long cooperation and are confident we will find a fair solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our main offer provides a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 45 days payment terms, we can offer €4.90 per unit with a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

As to the quality record data you cited, that does not change our position. While we note your comments on the quality record, our performance remains within agreed tolerances and does not warrant a price reduction. Our current defect rate for you is about 150 ppm. Furthermore, we appreciate your feedback and have forwarded your request for a cost breakdown to the relevant department. Please note that material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Option B: unit price EUR 4.46; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.42; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

We value our long cooperation and are confident we will find a fair solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your revised offer; however, the prices remain significantly below our required levels. 

As our current Angebot, we are pleased to present a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

In response to your adjustment, we can offer €4.89 per unit for a 24-month contract with 45 days payment terms. Specifically, we can also present a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please provide the market figures you referenced so we may review your basis for these target prices. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We acknowledge your slightly improved offer, but it still falls short of our required levels. 

We are pleased to submit our current Angebot of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. To accommodate your request for 60 days payment terms, we can offer €4.91 per unit for a 24-month contract, with a Zahlungsziel 60 days net. 

We must emphasize that our pricing leaves no room for further concessions. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

This offer remains valid for 7 days. We appreciate your interest in our extensive product range and look forward to your decision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
